gtia.quest.64DD2F37D28FCFCC.subtitle: More tiers are on their way.
gtia.quest.64DD2F37D28FCFCC.desc.0: You have reached the end of the chapters written so far. Extreme Voltage, space and the larger machines come next.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.title: Power Generation
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.subtitle: Every way to make EU, side by side.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.desc.0: Read this chapter as a table. Each row is an era of the game and opens when you reach that era's chapter. Each column is one way of making energy.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.desc.2: Across a row: what you can build right now, and how the options compare. Down a column: how one family grows. The cards on top list each generator's fuels with the EU one bucket gives, taken from this pack's recipes.
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.title: Steam Era
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.subtitle: Before the first circuit.
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.desc.0: Steam is your only energy at first, and the &6Primitive Steam Turbine&r turns some of it into Ultra Low Voltage power.
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.title: Low Voltage
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.subtitle: 32 V.
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.desc.0: Low Voltage machines take up to &e32 V&r. Every column has something to offer here; pick by the fuel you can make in quantity.
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.title: Medium Voltage
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.subtitle: 128 V.
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.desc.0: Medium Voltage machines take up to &e128 V&r. Feed them with generators of this row, or step up power from a lower row with a &6Transformer&r.
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.title: High Voltage
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.subtitle: 512 V.
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.desc.0: High Voltage machines take up to &e512 V&r. This is where the large multiblock turbines start to pay off.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.title: What Steam Turbines Burn
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.subtitle: Steam, and nothing else.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.desc.0: Turbines eat the steam of the column to their left. A boiler that keeps up with them is the real limit.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.title: What Combustion Burns
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.subtitle: Liquid fuels, best first.
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.0: Combustion Generators burn liquid fuels. The cheapest ones, &6Ethanol&r and &6Biodiesel&r, need no oil at all.
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.15: ...and 3 more; the recipe viewer lists them all.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.title: What Gas Turbines Burn
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.subtitle: Gases, best first.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.0: Gas Turbines burn gases and light hydrocarbons. Several of them come out of the same distillation that makes combustion fuel, so the two columns grow together.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.15: ...and 6 more; the recipe viewer lists them all.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.title: Steam Sources
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.subtitle: Boilers feed the steam column.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.desc.0: Boilers burn fuel and turn &6Water&r into &6Steam&r. They make no EU themselves: the turbines of the next column do.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.desc.2: &aCount your boilers first. A turbine is only as good as the steam behind it.&r
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.title: Solar Steam
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.subtitle: No fuel, only daylight.
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.desc.0: Solar boilers heat water with the sun. &aNo fuel at all&r, but &cnothing at night&r, and little steam per block. They help a boiler line; they rarely replace it.
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.title: Multiblock Generators
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.subtitle: When one block is not enough.
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.desc.0: Multiblock generators burn the same fuels as the columns to their left, in larger amounts. Their output depends on the &ddynamo hatch&r you give them, and turbines also on their &drotor&r.
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.title: Small Boiler
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.subtitle: Coal, Coke, anything that burns.
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.desc.0: The first steam source. Its high-pressure Steel version makes more steam from the same fuel.
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.title: Solar Boiler
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.subtitle: Free steam under the sun.
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.desc.0: No fuel at all: the sun heats the water. It needs Glass, so it comes after the Block mold. It makes little steam and none at night, so it helps a boiler rather than replacing it.
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.title: Large Bronze Boiler
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.subtitle: A multiblock steam source.
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.desc.0: The first multiblock boiler. Its controller asks for circuits, which is why it sits in this row and not the one above.
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.title: Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.subtitle: Your boilers, now at 32 V.
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.desc.0: The easiest LV generator: you already make the steam. Its card above shows how much steam one EU costs, so count your boilers before you count your turbines.
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.title: High-Pressure Solar Boiler
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.subtitle: Steel catches more sun.
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.desc.0: The Steel solar boiler makes more steam than the bronze one, still only in daylight.
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.title: Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.subtitle: Liquid fuel at 32 V.
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.desc.0: Burns the fuels of the card above. &6Ethanol&r from Infinity Ascension's &6Fermentation Vats&r is the one you can make without oil.
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.title: Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.subtitle: Gas at 32 V.
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.desc.0: Burns the gases of the card above. The &6Catalytic Dehydrator&r's &6Ethylene&r is one of them.
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.title: Large Steel Boiler
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.subtitle: More steam per block.
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.desc.0: The Steel multiblock boiler. Pair it with Large Steam Turbines or a wall of singleblock turbines.
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.title: MV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.subtitle: Same steam, higher voltage.
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.desc.0: Burns steam faster to put out &e128 V&r. Steam stays a fine choice as long as your boilers keep up.
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.title: MV Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.subtitle: Time to refine oil.
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.desc.0: At this voltage the better fuels of the card start to matter: &6Light Fuel&r, &6Diesel&r and &6Gasoline&r come from oil.
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.title: MV Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.subtitle: Refinery gases.
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.desc.0: Oil refining leaves gases behind; this turbine turns them into &e128 V&r instead of waste.
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.title: HV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.subtitle: The last singleblock steam turbine.
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.desc.0: &e512 V&r from steam. Beyond this, steam power continues only as a multiblock.
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.title: HV Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.subtitle: 512 V from liquid fuel.
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.desc.0: Burns the same fuels faster. A steady &6Diesel&r or &6Gasoline&r line keeps it fed.
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.title: HV Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.subtitle: 512 V from gas.
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.desc.0: The last singleblock gas turbine. &6Benzene&r is among the best fuels on its card.
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.title: Large Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.subtitle: Rotors and a dynamo hatch.
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.desc.0: A multiblock turbine: its output depends on the rotor you put in its holder and on the dynamo hatch it feeds. The rotor wears out and has to be replaced.
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.title: Ethanol
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.subtitle: Fuel from plants.
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.desc.0: Carry a bucket of &6Ethanol&r from your Fermentation Vat. It is the combustion fuel you can make from plants alone.
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.title: Ethylene
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.subtitle: Ethanol, one step further.
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.desc.0: Carry a bucket of &6Ethylene&r from the &6Catalytic Dehydrator&r. Burn it in a Gas Turbine, or keep it: it is also the base of plastics later on.
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.title: Cables
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.subtitle: Every cable has a limit.
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.desc.0: A cable has a voltage limit and an amperage limit, and loses a little energy per block. Too much of either and it burns.
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.title: Battery Buffer
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.subtitle: Store what you do not use yet.
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.desc.0: A &6Battery Buffer&r holds batteries and evens out the difference between what your generators make and what your machines draw.
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.title: Transformer
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.subtitle: Move power between rows.
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.desc.0: A &6Transformer&r steps voltage up or down by one tier. It is how a row of cheap generators feeds the machines of the next row.
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.title: Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.subtitle: How multiblocks take power.
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.desc.0: Multiblocks take power through &6Energy Hatches&r. Its voltage coil comes out of an electric Assembler. The hatch's tier decides the voltage the whole machine runs at.
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.title: Generator Array
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.subtitle: Any column, many at once.
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.desc.0: GTNA's &6Generator Array&r takes singleblock steam turbines, combustion generators or gas turbines and runs them inside one multiblock. Any one of the three columns opens it.
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.title: Wireless Networks
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.subtitle: Steam and electricity without pipes or cables.
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.desc.0: GTNA moves steam and electricity through the air. Steam hatches share steam over a wireless network. Electricity goes through the Nexus Flux Matrix: generators deposit energy into it and machines draw energy from it.
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.title: Wireless Steam Output Hatch
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.subtitle: Send steam into the network.
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.desc.0: Put the output hatch next to a boiler and its steam goes into the wireless network instead of into pipes.
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.title: Wireless Steam Input Hatch
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.subtitle: Draw steam from the network.
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.desc.0: Put the input hatch on a steam machine and it draws the steam it needs from the network.
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.title: Steel Wireless Steam Hatches
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.subtitle: More capacity.
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.desc.0: The Steel versions of the wireless steam hatches hold far more steam than the Bronze ones, which matters once you run several large machines.
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.title: Nexus Flux Matrix
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.subtitle: A wireless battery for the factory.
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.desc.0: The Nexus Flux Matrix is a large multiblock that stores EU and shares it wirelessly. Fill its interior with Nexus Capacitors: more and better capacitors mean more storage.
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.title: Nexus Capacitor
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.subtitle: Storage for the matrix.
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.desc.0: Nexus Capacitors fill the interior of the Flux Matrix. The basic one stores 160,000 EU; higher tiers store far more.
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.title: Nexus Linker
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.subtitle: Tie a hatch to the matrix.
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.desc.0: The Nexus Linker connects hatches to the Flux Matrix. Shift-click the matrix controller, then click the hatch you want to link.
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.title: Wireless Dynamo Hatch
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.subtitle: Deposit energy into the matrix.
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.desc.0: Put a Wireless Dynamo Hatch on a generator and link it with the Nexus Linker: the generator deposits its energy into the Flux Matrix.
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.title: Wireless Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.subtitle: Draw energy from the matrix.
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.desc.0: Put a Wireless Energy Hatch on a machine and link it with the Nexus Linker: the machine draws power from the Flux Matrix with no cable at all.
